hero.title: Jagan Nath University, Jaipur
hero.summary: Jagan Nath University’s Jaipur agriculture faculty offers a four-year agriculture honours degree at Chaksu. The department describes teaching laboratories, agronomic fields and protected-cultivation facilities. Its 2026–27 programme list supplies agriculture entry requirements; applicants should confirm the applicable entrance and counselling route.

overview.heading: Agriculture study at Chaksu
paragraphs: Jagan Nath University, Jaipur was established in 2008 under Rajasthan legislation. Its Faculty of Agriculture dates the start of B.Sc. Agriculture teaching to 2014–15. The agriculture setting includes agronomic fields, teaching laboratories and farm machinery, linking the degree to crop-production practice.

The faculty describes protected cultivation, composting, irrigation and medicinal-plant units. These offer useful questions for a campus visit: how frequently students use each unit, which crops are grown for teaching, and how practical assessment works. The university offers other agriculture-related qualifications as well, but applicants should compare each programme’s admission requirements and accreditation separately.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture
programmes.summary: The four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture is identified in the official 2026–27 programme list. Departmental teaching includes agricultural sciences with field and laboratory facilities.
programmes.eligibility: 2026–27 official programme list: 10+2 science with 50% marks and Agriculture/Biology/Chemistry/Mathematics/Physics; the document states a 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/MBC/SAP/EWS categories. Confirm the accepted subject combination.
programmes.admission_route: The 2026–27 programme list says JET/ICAR. The university also maps agriculture on its CUET 2026–27 page; confirm which channel and counselling rules apply to the intended seat.

fees.note: The verified Jaipur 2026–27 programme document did not supply a readable agriculture fee amount. Fees from the similarly named NCR/Haryana university are not transferable.

programmes.icar_scope_note: The audited ICAR row covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at Jagannath University, Jaipur for 2022-03-17 to 2027-03-16. Printed intake is retained in recognition as historical scope.

admissions.heading: Planning an application to JU Jaipur
admissions.intro: Use the Jaipur university’s 2026–27 programme list, which gives agriculture-specific academic requirements. The agriculture selection cell names JET/ICAR, while the official CUET page also maps the degree. Ask admissions to reconcile those routes before registering for an examination or paying.
eligibility_points: The 2026–27 list sets a 50% science requirement with the stated agricultural/science subjects.
The same document lists a 5% relaxation for its specified reserved categories.

steps.title: Confirm the current prospectus
steps.text: Ask the admissions office for the applicable intake, subject requirements and selection rules before submitting an application.

steps.title: Request a written cost statement
steps.text: Obtain tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation options and refund terms for the intended entry year.

campus.heading: Protected cultivation and agronomic fields
campus.intro: The faculty page describes 13 laboratories, agronomic fields, a tractor and farm machinery. It also identifies a polyhouse, vermicompost unit, drip and sprinkler irrigation, and medicinal/aromatic plants. This is an undated institutional inventory, so applicants should check current access and teaching schedules.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The university lists merit support and government scholarship routes. Its scholarship page specifically links a Rajasthan agriculture incentive for female students. Eligibility, amount and current application dates must be checked with the administering department; no automatic award is promised.

faqs.question: Is this the Jaipur or NCR university?
faqs.answer: This profile concerns Jagan Nath University, Jaipur at Chaksu. The NCR/Haryana institution has a different website and its fees should not be used here.

faqs.question: What is the agriculture degree duration?
faqs.answer: The Jaipur 2026–27 programme list specifies four years.

faqs.question: Which admission route is published?
faqs.answer: The programme list says JET/ICAR, while the official CUET page also maps agriculture. Confirm the applicable channel with admissions.

faqs.question: What agricultural facilities are described?
faqs.answer: The faculty lists agronomic fields, laboratories, a polyhouse, irrigation systems and farm machinery.

faqs.question: Does ICAR cover every course in the faculty?
faqs.answer: The audited row specifically records B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture for 17 March 2022 to 16 March 2027. Other degrees are not automatically included.

faqs.question: What entry qualification is published for JU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: 2026–27 official programme list: 10+2 science with 50% marks and Agriculture/Biology/Chemistry/Mathematics/Physics; the document states a 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/MBC/SAP/EWS categories. Confirm the accepted subject combination.

faqs.question: Which scholarship or support information is published for JU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: The university lists merit support and government scholarship routes. Its scholarship page specifically links a Rajasthan agriculture incentive for female students. Eligibility, amount and current application dates must be checked with the administering department; no automatic award is promised. The university scholarship page links the Department of Agriculture’s Incentive to Girls route. Current award amount and applicant conditions were not verified.

faqs.question: What establishment year is documented for JU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Jagan Nath University, Jaipur is recorded as established in 2008.

faqs.question: Where is the official application information for JU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: https://cdn.jagannathuniversity.org/docs/admissions/Program-List-Fee-Structure-2026-27-JU-Jaipur.pdf. Read the programme, campus and applicable intake instructions on this official channel.

faqs.question: How can applicants contact JU Jaipur?
faqs.answer: Public telephone: +91 6377991003; Public email: admission@jagannathuniversity.org. These are institutional contact details, not an Agrico admissions guarantee.
